projects.title: Qwen Create Agent Teams
projects.subtitle: A multi-agent system for end-to-end video creation
projects.intro: Developed Skill creation and evaluation capabilities for creators, and contributed to Runtime optimization to support reusable creation workflows and Skill iteration.
bullets: Skill creation Agent

Helped launch a Skill creation Agent that extracts node capabilities, connections, inputs, outputs, and parameter configurations from canvas workflows, packaging reusable steps into editable Skill drafts. Used multimodal content understanding to break down shot structures, asset characteristics, and expression. Contributed to a supply of 100+ quality Skills.
Skill evaluation system

Built layered test sets, evaluation criteria, and an automated execution platform. Defined rules and generated targeted instructions for each Skill’s capabilities and use cases. For each instruction, controlled model and tool conditions to compare no-Skill and different Skill-version results, assessing both node quality and end-to-end outcomes. Used tool-call traces and node outputs to locate failures and support iteration. The platform launched internally, covering 100+ Skills and their versions.
Runtime optimization & model adaptation

Designed a Subagent to distill conversation history, separating essential information from compressible process details as conversations and tool outputs accumulated. Long-task Token usage decreased by 5%. Adapted existing Skills for Wan 3.0 and Qwen Image 3.0 by identifying reusable workflows and affected model calls, then updating Skill interfaces and model routing.

projects.title: Qwen Create: overseas product exploration
projects.subtitle: North American demand validation & growth-feature planning
projects.intro: At the early overseas product stage, developed market-entry recommendations, growth-feature choices, and website planning to support user growth.
bullets: Market selection & entry strategy
Evaluated candidate markets using organic traffic distribution, regional willingness and ability to pay, and acquisition-cost differences; selected North America as the initial market.
Overseas marketing evaluation

Participated in Agent evaluation for North American and Latin American e-commerce and advertising scenarios. Analyzed intent understanding, marketing scripts, visuals, and editing, and authored the evaluation report covering strengths, limitations, and improvement directions.
Search demand & SEO analysis

Researched overseas demand and North American product opportunities, selecting background removal and AI face swap as growth entry points based on search demand and conversion potential. Identified that features proven in China, such as old-photo restoration and people removal, had limited North American search demand and were better suited to display-ad creative. Helped adjust acquisition strategy and worked with marketing and growth teams on execution, with overseas users growing by 50%.
Website MVP design

Mapped search intent, including tool discovery and creative tasks, to existing product capabilities. Planned feature and scenario pages, specifying examples, input requirements, and feature entry points to better connect search traffic with relevant product capabilities.

experience.role: Creator Product Intern · Commercial Product Strategy
experience.intro: Worked on creator discovery, collaboration workflows, and creator supply to improve brand advertising and creator monetization.
bullets: Creator search & matching

Contributed to creator-label improvements, including periodic and time-sensitive labels, and a semantic vector retrieval approach to support cross-category matching. Used A/B experiments to track search clicks and orders, investigate failure cases, and iterate matching strategies. Search-result click-through rate was 21% in the treatment group versus 18% in the control; post-search order conversion increased from 4.0% to 4.4%.
Platform feature improvements

Analyzed major e-commerce clients’ budgets and transaction constraints, reviewed product rules, and validated rule boundaries and risks. Helped productize negotiated minimum prices, collaboration scale, custom timing, and targeted creator invitations. The updated features supported client requests worth over RMB 3 million, and the number of collaborating creators grew by 135%.
Creator opportunity matching

Organized campaigns including 618 Spark Gala and home-renovation creator recruitment. Brand collaboration orders grew 25% month over month. Recommended creators represented 2% of the overall creator pool but contributed 11% of order value; more than 400 creators received their first commercial collaboration.

experience.intro: Supported Changi Airport, Pepsi, and other clients through digital product proposals, creator campaigns, and client coordination.
bullets: Digital product design

Independently developed digital product features and social-media analysis for Changi Airport’s China communications proposal. Based on Chinese users’ mobile-platform habits and overseas shopping behavior, proposed shifting from website-led traffic to platform-based touchpoints, with platform roles and optimization recommendations. The strategy was adopted in the final proposal.
Creator campaigns

Defined creator content directions and platform communication approaches for Pepsi’s food campaign. Screened creators by audience, content style, and past performance; completed 130+ creator assessments, 65+ script reviews, and 50 collaborations in one month. Iterated the collaboration process, improving script approval rate by 30%; the screening criteria were reused.

projects.title: Creator content diagnosis & topic co-creation assistant
projects.label: Personal project · Vibe Coding
bullets: Built from personal publishing and creator-consulting experience, the project serves smaller creators who have a few successful posts but no repeatable method. It uses account history and reader feedback to identify effective topics, content structures, and core audiences, connecting account diagnosis, topic generation, and structural review. Multiple agents simulate different audience perspectives, discuss candidate content, and summarize feedback. Applied to 50+ pieces of content, with average post readership increasing by approximately 18%.
